item.title: Remittance status for practices
item.body: Remittance status shows each payment period with its status. SCHEDULED means the remittance is planned for the next payment run in your provider agreement. SENT means the payment was issued on the date shown. Changes to payout destinations or tax details are never made by phone; they require the secure provider portal and a specialist.
